description: Retrieves a list of Stripe customers, with options to filter by email, creation date, or test clock, and support for pagination.

created.description: Filters by creation date. Use a dictionary with keys like 'gte', 'lte', 'gt', 'lt' and Unix timestamp values (e.g., {'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}).
created.title: Created

email.description: Filters customers by a case-sensitive email address.
email.title: Email

ending_before.description: Pagination cursor; retrieves objects created before the specified object ID to fetch the previous page.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

limit.description: Maximum number of customer objects to return (range 1-100). Defaults to 10 if unspecified.
limit.title: Limit

starting_after.description: Pagination cursor; retrieves objects created after the specified object ID to fetch the next page.
starting_after.title: Starting After

test_clock.description: Filters customers by the specified test clock ID. If omitted, returns only live mode customers.
test_clock.title: Test Clock

invoice_credit_balance.description: The current multi-currency balances, if any, being stored on the customer. Keys are three-letter ISO currency codes (e.g., 'usd', 'eur') and values are integers representing amounts in the smallest currency unit. If positive, the customer has a credit to apply to their next invoice denominated in that currency. If negative, the customer has an amount owed that will be added to their next invoice denominated in that currency. These balances do not refer to any unpaid invoices.
